newsitem.title: USA: Debris from TWA plane lands in St. Louis street.
newsitem.headline: Debris from TWA plane lands in St. Louis street.

text.p: A TWA plane inbound from Florida dropped the door to its landing gear on a downtown St. Louis street Thursday, authorities said.
No one was injured, but traffic came to an abrupt halt when the cabinet-sized metal object fell in front of city hall.

Officials from the airline informed the Federal Aviation Administration that an L-1011 plane arriving in St. Louis from Orlando about the same time was missing one of its landing gear doors. Authorities were checking serial numbers found on the debris.
An investigation was under way to determine what caused the door to dislodge, FAA spokeswoman Kathleen Bergen said.
